sentenceSets.sentence: His position on the matter oscillated with the pressures of the moment rather than following any consistent principle.

answerChoices.reasoning: Vacillated means wavered between options or was uncertain, but doesn't capture the image of swinging back and forth between positions.
Fluctuated means varied irregularly, but doesn't specifically suggest the rhythm of swinging back and forth between two positions.
Wavered means hesitated or showed uncertainty, but doesn't convey the regular back-and-forth movement like a pendulum.
Swayed means influenced or bent, but suggests external influence rather than the mechanical back-and-forth motion implied by oscillate.
Shifted means moved or changed position, but doesn't suggest the regular, rhythmic back-and-forth pattern of oscillating.
Drifted means moved gradually or aimlessly, but doesn't capture the sense of swinging between positions repeatedly.
Veered means changed direction sharply, but suggests a one-time turn rather than repeated back-and-forth movement.
Pivoted means turned or rotated on a point, but doesn't suggest the rhythmic swinging that oscillate implies.
Remained means stayed fixed or unchanged, contradicting the image of swinging back and forth.
Solidified means became firm and unchanging, the opposite of swinging between different positions.
Stabilized means became steady and fixed, contradicting the regular back-and-forth movement of oscillation.
